description:
From the fz-kdt.183 rule review (2026-09-03, attacks-r2/w2_whole_union.fz):
DispatchDemand::Whole => ty is verbatim in convergence_collapse_ty (types/
mod.rs:944) -- no collapse at all -- and under 183's transitive demand a
callee that pattern-matches a literal (probe(:stop) -> Region::Equal ->
Whole) raises the FORWARDER's accumulator to Whole: grow/2 [ListShape(Ignore),
Whole] keys 1 -> 2 activations, and fz-y6w's termination argument for that
slot is gone -- only the ascent settling on its own bounds it. Corpus census
at the rule: 713 mask rows FINAL != LOCAL, 344 rows over 174 functions gain a
forwarding-introduced Whole; 0 behaviour movers, no divergence constructed
(the pre-existing self-nesting hang, fz-kdt.177's class, dominates at base
and rule alike). Pre-existing on the LOCAL half (a Whole slot never
collapsed); 183 makes it reach across function boundaries and documents it
("a Whole slot has no collapse and forwarding can hand a Whole up"). Direction:
Whole should still collapse on the axes clause selection does not read
(Region::Equal on an atom asks only the atom axis; the list family beside it
is freight), i.e. Whole is too coarse a demand -- the mask should carry the
AXES a question reads, not "everything". CONCORDANT: fz-y6w (bounded
specialization), fz-kdt.65 (the return ladder's budget), fz-kdt.177
(nesting), fz-kdt.140 (2^arity where the callee reads no position: the tuple
analogue of over-broad demand).

comments.text: fz-kdt.183 landed (2e0bb2706): DispatchDemand::Whole returns ty verbatim (no collapse), and forwarding now hands a Whole UP from a callee that pattern-matches a literal: grow/2's accumulator loses its collapse, 1 -> 2 keys, identical at union widths 3/6/9/12 (bounded, measured). 344 rows / 174 functions gain a forwarding-introduced Whole. fz-y6w's termination argument does not cover such a slot; stated in convergence_collapse's doc, type-specialization.md and addressed-arrow.md. The one divergent shape found (self-nesting accumulator) hangs at base with no forwarding at all -- fz-kdt.177's class, not this.

title: A Whole demand at a recursive slot has no convergence collapse, and forwarding now hands a Whole up: an accumulator loses its fz-y6w bound because a callee pattern-matches a literal (344 corpus rows)
